pkgmetadata.longdescription: Perl ACME (RFC 8555 / Let's Encrypt) client library used by pxvirt for automated TLS certificate management. Provides: PVE::ACME — ACME protocol client (JWS, account, order) PVE::ACME::Challenge — base class for challenge handlers PVE::ACME::DNSChallenge — DNS-01 challenge via acme.sh plugins PVE::ACME::StandAlone — HTTP-01 standalone challenge server
